topic: Language, Proverbs: Find the correct synonyms
title: Synonyms: Words with the Same Meaning

explanation.tr:
Eş anlamlı kelimeler (synonyms) aynı ya da çok yakın anlama gelir. Yazarken tekrarı önlemek için çok kullanışlıdır.
• big = large, huge (çok büyük)
• small = little, tiny (çok küçük)
• happy = glad, cheerful
• sad = unhappy
• begin = start
• finish = end
• quick = fast
• smart = clever, intelligent
• difficult = hard
• look for = search for
Dikkat: eş anlamlılar her zaman birbirinin yerine kullanılamaz: a big brother (ağabey) ≠ a large brother.
explanation.tk:
Manydaş sözler (synonyms) birmeňzeş ýa-da örän ýakyn manyny berýär. Ýazanyňda gaýtalanmazlyk üçin örän peýdaly.
• big = large, huge (örän uly)
• small = little, tiny (örän kiçi)
• happy = glad, cheerful
• sad = unhappy
• begin = start
• finish = end
• quick = fast
• smart = clever, intelligent
• difficult = hard
• look for = search for
Üns beriň: manydaşlar hemişe biri-biriniň ýerine ulanylyp bilinmeýär: a big brother (uly dogan) ≠ a large brother.
explanation.ru:
Синонимы — слова с одинаковым или очень близким значением. Они помогают избежать повторов.
• big = large, huge (огромный)
• small = little, tiny (крошечный)
• happy = glad, cheerful
• sad = unhappy
• begin = start
• finish = end
• quick = fast
• smart = clever, intelligent
• difficult = hard
• look for = search for
Внимание: синонимы не всегда взаимозаменяемы: a big brother (старший брат) ≠ a large brother.

examples.en: They live in a large house.

I'm glad to see you.

explanation.tr:
Headword (üst kavram), bir grup kelimeyi kapsayan genel kelimedir. Kelimeleri gruplamak hatırlamayı kolaylaştırır.
• fruit: apple, banana, grape, melon
• vegetables: carrot, potato, onion, cucumber
• animals: dog, horse, camel, sheep
• furniture: table, chair, sofa, wardrobe
• clothes: shirt, dress, jacket, trousers
• colours: red, blue, green, yellow
• jobs: teacher, doctor, driver, farmer
• transport: bus, train, plane, bicycle
• weather: rain, snow, wind, sun
explanation.tk:
Headword (umumy düşünje) bir topar sözi öz içine alýan umumy söz. Sözleri toparlamak ýatda saklamagy aňsatlaşdyrýar.
• fruit: apple, banana, grape, melon
• vegetables: carrot, potato, onion, cucumber
• animals: dog, horse, camel, sheep
• furniture: table, chair, sofa, wardrobe
• clothes: shirt, dress, jacket, trousers
• colours: red, blue, green, yellow
• jobs: teacher, doctor, driver, farmer
• transport: bus, train, plane, bicycle
• weather: rain, snow, wind, sun
explanation.ru:
Headword (обобщающее слово) объединяет группу слов. Группировка помогает лучше запоминать.
• fruit: apple, banana, grape, melon
• vegetables: carrot, potato, onion, cucumber
• animals: dog, horse, camel, sheep
• furniture: table, chair, sofa, wardrobe
• clothes: shirt, dress, jacket, trousers
• colours: red, blue, green, yellow
• jobs: teacher, doctor, driver, farmer
• transport: bus, train, plane, bicycle
• weather: rain, snow, wind, sun

explanation.tr:
Zıt anlamlı kelimeler (opposites) birlikte öğrenilince daha kolay hatırlanır:
• big ↔ small, tall ↔ short, long ↔ short
• hot ↔ cold, old ↔ new / young
• happy ↔ sad, good ↔ bad
• fast ↔ slow, easy ↔ difficult
• open ↔ close(d), full ↔ empty
• day ↔ night, up ↔ down, in ↔ out
Dikkat: old'un iki zıttı var: an old car ↔ a new car; an old man ↔ a young man.
explanation.tk:
Garşylykly sözler (opposites) bilelikde öwrenilse, aňsat ýatda galýar:
• big ↔ small, tall ↔ short, long ↔ short
• hot ↔ cold, old ↔ new / young
• happy ↔ sad, good ↔ bad
• fast ↔ slow, easy ↔ difficult
• open ↔ close(d), full ↔ empty
• day ↔ night, up ↔ down, in ↔ out
Üns beriň: old sözüniň iki garşylygy bar: an old car ↔ a new car; an old man ↔ a young man.
explanation.ru:
Антонимы (opposites) легче запомнить парами:
• big ↔ small, tall ↔ short, long ↔ short
• hot ↔ cold, old ↔ new / young
• happy ↔ sad, good ↔ bad
• fast ↔ slow, easy ↔ difficult
• open ↔ close(d), full ↔ empty
• day ↔ night, up ↔ down, in ↔ out
Внимание: у old два антонима: an old car ↔ a new car; an old man ↔ a young man.

explanation.tr:
Sıfatların zıtları iki şekilde yapılır:
1. Farklı bir kelime: rich ↔ poor, cheap ↔ expensive, heavy ↔ light, strong ↔ weak, wide ↔ narrow, clean ↔ dirty, loud ↔ quiet, early ↔ late, dangerous ↔ safe, polite ↔ rude
2. Ön ek (prefix): un- (happy → unhappy, kind → unkind), im- (possible → impossible, polite → impolite), in- (correct → incorrect), dis- (honest → dishonest), il- (legal → illegal), ir- (regular → irregular)
Dikkat: 'light' iki anlamlı: heavy ↔ light (ağırlık), dark ↔ light (renk/ışık).
explanation.tk:
Sypatlaryň garşylyklary iki ýol bilen ýasalýar:
1. Başga söz: rich ↔ poor, cheap ↔ expensive, heavy ↔ light, strong ↔ weak, wide ↔ narrow, clean ↔ dirty, loud ↔ quiet, early ↔ late, dangerous ↔ safe, polite ↔ rude
2. Öňgoşulma (prefix): un- (happy → unhappy, kind → unkind), im- (possible → impossible, polite → impolite), in- (correct → incorrect), dis- (honest → dishonest), il- (legal → illegal), ir- (regular → irregular)
Üns beriň: 'light' iki manyly: heavy ↔ light (agramy), dark ↔ light (reňk/ýagtylyk).
explanation.ru:
Антонимы прилагательных образуются двумя способами:
1. Другое слово: rich ↔ poor, cheap ↔ expensive, heavy ↔ light, strong ↔ weak, wide ↔ narrow, clean ↔ dirty, loud ↔ quiet, early ↔ late, dangerous ↔ safe, polite ↔ rude
2. Приставка: un- (happy → unhappy, kind → unkind), im- (possible → impossible, polite → impolite), in- (correct → incorrect), dis- (honest → dishonest), il- (legal → illegal), ir- (regular → irregular)
Внимание: 'light' многозначно: heavy ↔ light (вес), dark ↔ light (цвет/свет).

explanation.tr:
İsimlerin de zıtları vardır:
• Kişiler: man ↔ woman, boy ↔ girl, husband ↔ wife, king ↔ queen, teacher ↔ student, friend ↔ enemy, winner ↔ loser
• Kavramlar: love ↔ hate, war ↔ peace, success ↔ failure, beginning ↔ end, question ↔ answer, truth ↔ lie, joy ↔ sadness
• Zaman/doğa: day ↔ night, summer ↔ winter, sunrise ↔ sunset, north ↔ south, east ↔ west
• Ön ekle: advantage ↔ disadvantage, order ↔ disorder
explanation.tk:
Atlaryň hem garşylyklary bar:
• Adamlar: man ↔ woman, boy ↔ girl, husband ↔ wife, king ↔ queen, teacher ↔ student, friend ↔ enemy, winner ↔ loser
• Düşünjeler: love ↔ hate, war ↔ peace, success ↔ failure, beginning ↔ end, question ↔ answer, truth ↔ lie, joy ↔ sadness
• Wagt/tebigat: day ↔ night, summer ↔ winter, sunrise ↔ sunset, north ↔ south, east ↔ west
• Öňgoşulma bilen: advantage ↔ disadvantage, order ↔ disorder
explanation.ru:
У существительных тоже есть антонимы:
• Люди: man ↔ woman, boy ↔ girl, husband ↔ wife, king ↔ queen, teacher ↔ student, friend ↔ enemy, winner ↔ loser
• Понятия: love ↔ hate, war ↔ peace, success ↔ failure, beginning ↔ end, question ↔ answer, truth ↔ lie, joy ↔ sadness
• Время/природа: day ↔ night, summer ↔ winter, sunrise ↔ sunset, north ↔ south, east ↔ west
• С приставкой: advantage ↔ disadvantage, order ↔ disorder
